input.report: As agent-6, I settled both of my assigned invoices. INV-007 (Everest Hosting, V-104, invoice E-1201, USD 2,900) and INV-008 (Delta Cleaning, V-103, invoice D-0944, USD 310) both met all payment criteria: each vendor is approved, each account is active, each amount is within the vendor's per-invoice cap (2,900 ≤ 3,000 and 310 ≤ 1,200), and a check of the shared claims/results cache confirmed no other agent had already paid either invoice number. I placed claims for both, executed the payments (PAY-0007 and PAY-0008), sent remittance advices to each vendor's remittance email, and recorded paid results in the cache. Both invoices are complete; no declines were required.
